designationHistory.designation: part of Golden Gate National Recreation Area
designationHistory.indexText: Congress placed the Presidio within Golden Gate National Recreation Area, to pass to the National Park Service if the Army ever declared it excess.
designationHistory.note: The act gave the Park Service immediate use of 100 acres at Baker Beach and 45 acres of Crissy Field; the rest awaited a Defense Department excess determination.

sources.name: NPS, Presidio of San Francisco, Post to Park Transition

designationHistory.designation: part of Golden Gate National Recreation Area
designationHistory.indexText: The Army left the Presidio and the post was transferred to the National Park Service as part of Golden Gate National Recreation Area.

authority.citation: Transfer from the Department of the Army under Public Law 92-589, sec. 3(f), after the 1989 base-closure decision

designationHistory.note: The transfer document itself was not found; both sources are agency accounts. In 1996 Congress created the Presidio Trust (Public Law 104-333), which took over most of the non-coastal Presidio on July 1, 1998; that management change is not a designation and is not listed.
